name: R5.3 Draft a quote from the current price table only

nodes.name: Step 1: Ready to quote
nodes.notes: Your CRM calls this when an opportunity is marked "ready to quote". Body: {opportunity_id, revision}.

nodes.name: Each morning: price list expiry warning
nodes.notes: The failure table's warning a week ahead of the price list's expiry.

assignments.name: sales_lead
assignments.value: <your sales lead, who prices off-list lines>

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values for your company; nothing else in the workflow hard-codes them.

parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO key_log (recipe, key, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in progress') ON CONFLICT (recipe, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key), skipped AS (UPDATE key_log SET copies_skipped = copies_skipped + 1 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reserved) = 1 AS is_new, $2::text AS key

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R5.3", $('Step 1: Ready to quote').first().json.body.opportunity_id + ':' + $('Step 1: Ready to quote').first().json.body.revision] }}

nodes.name: Step 2: Reserve key
nodes.notes: Key log: refuses a second copy in the same step (book Chapter 2).

nodes.name: Duplicate: stop
nodes.notes: This opportunity revision was drafted before.

nodes.name: Step 3: Rule: prices and terms in date?

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: [$('Config').first().json.sales_lead, $('Config').first().json.price_list_owner], subject: 'Quote stopped: price list or terms expired', text: 'Opportunity ' + $('Step 1: Ready to quote').first().json.body.opportunity_id + ' was not drafted: ' + $json.expired.join('; ') }) }}

parameters.query: DELETE FROM key_log WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 RETURNING key

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R5.3", $('Step 1: Ready to quote').first().json.body.opportunity_id + ':' + $('Step 1: Ready to quote').first().json.body.revision] }}

nodes.name: Step 3: Release the key
nodes.notes: Stopped before any draft, so marking ready again after a new list is published drafts it.

nodes.name: Step 4: Price each line
nodes.notes: Fixed rule; the AI never sees a price.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO exception_queue (recipe, item, reason, detail, owner) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R5.3", $('Step 1: Ready to quote').first().json.body.opportunity_id, "off-list line", 'Unpriced off-list line(s) ' + $('Step 4: Price each line').first().json.off_list_lines.join(', ') + '; price before R5.4 routes it', $('Config').first().json.sales_lead] }}

nodes.name: Step 4: Flag off-list line for Ben
nodes.notes: Exception queue: a named person works through it (book Chapters 2 and 16).

nodes.name: Step 5: Build the AI request
nodes.notes: Fills the prompt from the recipe's prompts/ file; the input is data, never instructions.

nodes.name: Step 5: AI call
nodes.notes: Claude Haiku 5.5 by default (Config); tools none; the reply is checked by the rule that follows.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { route: 'ai error', reason: 'AI error after one retry: ' + String(($json.error && $json.error.message) || '') } }];

nodes.name: Step 7: Rule: placeholders filled, no other number?
nodes.notes: The rule decides; any number no placeholder supplied fails the draft.

nodes.name: Step 8: Save the draft for R5.4
nodes.notes: Stamped with the price list version; "awaiting approval" starts R5.4.
